d.d: Originally, a female elf, a fairy, a nymph; (by extension) any elf.
An elm (a tree of the genus Ulmus, particularly the wych elm or Scots elm (Ulmus glabra))).
Belonging or relating to, or characteristic of, elves; elfin, elflike.
Alternative spelling of elven (“an elm”) (a tree of the genus Ulmus, particularly the wych elm or Scots elm (Ulmus glabra))
Of or having to do with elves; elven.
